# Slope and ruggedness derivation

*Generated by `scripts/geo_derive_slope.py` on 2026-08-20T05:08:50+00:00. Do not edit by hand.*

Closes the Task 1 hand-off: terrain layers sourced from the sampled DEM
clips instead of the Atlas's inaccessible per-country RIX/elevation.
Method: Horn 3x3 slope with per-row metre spacing (N-S 111,132 m/deg; E-W 111,320 x cos(lat) m/deg); Riley TRI for ruggedness.
The choice of aggregation statistic and of any threshold is deliberately
left to Task 5 — the tables below are evidence, not decisions.

## Derived rasters

| File | Source DEM | Variable | Units |
|---|---|---|---|
| `srtm-gl3_slope-horn_90m_new-england-rez.tif` | GL3 ~90 m | Horn slope | degrees |
| `srtm-gl1_slope-horn_30m_glen-innes.tif` | GL1 ~30 m | Horn slope | degrees |
| `srtm-gl1_tri_30m_glen-innes.tif` | GL1 ~30 m | Riley TRI | metres |

## Evidence 1 — GL1 (30 m) vs GL3 (90 m) slope, wind-farm sub-window

GL1 slope was computed at 30 m then averaged 3x3 to the GL3 footprint;
GL3 slope was computed directly at 90 m. GA advises that unsmoothed
1-second SRTM is noisy for terrain attributes; this measures what that
means at screening scale.

| Product | Mean | Median | P90 | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GL1 slope aggregated to 90 m | 6.28 | 4.90 | 12.54 | 41.05 |
| GL3 slope computed at 90 m | 4.96 | 3.77 | 10.52 | 35.22 |

Per-pixel difference (GL1-at-90m minus GL3): mean +1.31 deg, mean absolute 1.67 deg, P95 absolute 4.52 deg.

## Evidence 2 — slope aggregated to the 0.05 deg (~5 km) analysis grid

GL3 slope aggregated in 60 x 60-pixel blocks over the full
study window (40 x 40 cells; the sample grid is offset from the exact
0.05-degree lattice by half a GL3 pixel, ~46 m, immaterial as evidence).

| Statistic | Cell mean | Cell median | Cell P90 | Cell max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| mean of 90 m slope per cell | 5.39 | 4.43 | 10.74 | 24.89 |
| max of 90 m slope per cell | 20.98 | 20.40 | 33.66 | 55.91 |
| p90 of 90 m slope per cell | 10.36 | 8.75 | 19.88 | 39.93 |

### Share of cells crossing candidate thresholds

| Threshold | mean | max | p90 |
|---|---|---|---|
| > 5 deg | 42.5% | 95.4% | 75.3% |
| > 10 deg | 11.6% | 85.7% | 42.1% |
| > 15 deg | 3.4% | 69.2% | 22.6% |
| > 20 deg | 0.7% | 51.9% | 9.9% |

Reading: a max-based rule excludes far more cells than a mean-based rule at
the same threshold — the statistic is as consequential as the threshold
itself. Decision deferred to Task 5.

## Caveats

- SRTM GL1/GL3 are unsmoothed; GA's DEM-S (smoothed) is the recommended
  base for terrain attributes but is not scriptably accessible (HTTP 403,
  see source register). Evidence 1 bounds the consequence at screening scale.
- Slope rasters are stored as int16 with a 0.01-degree scale factor and
  TRI with a 0.1-metre scale factor (declared in the GeoTIFF band scales);
  quantisation error is far below the method error.
- The GL3 mosaic declares nodata=0, which conflates sea level with voids;
  this inland window contains no zero pixels (see inspection reports).
